definition.simple: Using information in a test that you could not have known at the time of the trade.
definition.balanced: Examples: drawing a level using a candle that formed after your entry, or reading a bar's close before that bar has finished. It makes a [[backtest]] look better than real trading could be. Replay helps by hiding future bars.

example: You mark a "clear" support line on a chart, but the bounce that made it clear happened after your planned entry.
